209acacdafa043b9.job_title: Brand Operations Manager (Trial Loyalty Programs & In Store)
209acacdafa043b9.description: About the Role Procter & Gamble is seeking a Brand Operations Manager specializing in Trial Loyalty Programs and In-Store initiatives. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and focuses on enhancing brand presence, driving consumer engagement, and optimizing shopper experiences. The role involves leading initiatives that connect brands with consumers, encourage product trial, and strengthen brand loyalty through effective in-store strategies. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead strategies for product trial and consumer acquisition to recruit new consumers and accelerate brand penetration. Design and execute consumer loyalty and engagement programs to strengthen brand affinity, encourage repeat purchases, and build long-term consumer relationships. Lead in-store marketing and shopper activation strategies, ensuring brand visibility, strong execution, and compelling consumer experiences at the point of purchase. Develop integrated activation plans across relevant consumer and retail touchpoints, ensuring consistency with overall brand strategies. Collaborate with Brand Management, Sales, Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Commercial teams, and external agencies to achieve business objectives. Track campaign effectiveness, evaluate KPIs, measure ROI, and translate consumer and shopper insights into actionable growth opportunities. Identify new opportunities, explore emerging engagement platforms, and continuously enhance trial, loyalty, and in-store activation initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to build brands, drive consumer engagement, and create impactful shopper experiences. Experience in developing and executing trial, loyalty, and in-store activation programs. Work Environment and Company Culture At Procter & Gamble, employees work with established brands and collaborate with diverse teams. The company fosters an environment that supports ownership, innovation, continuous learning, and career development, enabling individuals to contribute to consumer and business growth. Application Process Individuals interested in building consumer connections, driving brand growth, and transforming shopper experiences are encouraged to apply.

20a8c9947c9a662c.description: About the Role SO/ Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Director of Sales to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. This full-time role involves shaping the sales strategy and building key relationships to position the hotel effectively from its pre-opening phase. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the commercial strategy to establish SO/ Jeddah as a leading lifestyle destination. Identify new revenue opportunities through market insights, strategic partnerships, and sales initiatives. Collaborate with ownership and hotel leadership to achieve revenue and market share goals. Lead pre-opening activities by identifying key audiences, partnerships, and business opportunities. Establish sales structures, tools, systems, and pipelines to ensure commercial readiness. Engage the market and build strategic relationships to promote the SO/ brand. Oversee forecasting, reporting, and performance analysis across all market segments. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and demand patterns to inform commercial decisions. Partner with Revenue Management to optimize pricing, positioning, and business mix. Implement sales processes, account management practices, and commercial disciplines. Drive pipeline performance, conversion rates, and account growth to meet and exceed targets. Ensure commercial activities align with operational capabilities and guest expectations. Build and develop a high-performing sales team focused on creativity, accountability, and collaboration. Coach and mentor team members, fostering a culture of continuous growth. Support local talent development, with an emphasis on Saudi national capability and succession planning. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in sales, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to shape and execute commercial strategies. Experience in pre-opening phases of hotel operations is beneficial. Strong analytical skills for market trend analysis and performance reporting. Proven leadership skills in building and developing sales teams. Benefits Opportunities for career progression within a global family of brands. Healthcare benefits and a competitive salary. Learning and development opportunities to enhance skills and professional growth. A collaborative and innovative work culture.

206b3e5e3031741a.description: About the Role National Supreme Co. (Al-Amal Ice Cream) is seeking an experienced Fleet & Maintenance Manager to oversee fleet maintenance operations. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring vehicle reliability, optimizing workshop performance, and minimizing downtime. Role Purpose The Fleet & Maintenance Manager will lead all aspects of fleet maintenance, with a strong emphasis on implementing preventive maintenance strategies, achieving cost efficiency, and maintaining high operational standards for commercial and refrigerated vehicles. The role requires a proactive approach to managing maintenance programs and ensuring fleet readiness. Key Responsibilities Oversee maintenance operations for commercial vehicles, delivery trucks, and the refrigerated fleet. Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance programs. Manage workshop operations, maintenance technicians, and external service providers. Ensure fleet readiness, operational reliability, and timely resolution of breakdowns. Monitor maintenance costs, fuel consumption, vehicle utilization, and fleet performance KPIs. Manage spare parts inventory, maintenance budgets, and supplier relationships. Utilize ERP systems, Excel, and fleet tracking systems for monitoring and reporting. Coordinate with relevant departments to minimize downtime and maintain operational continuity. Conduct periodic visits to branches and operational sites as required. Ensure compliance with vehicle safety and maintenance standards. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering, or a relevant technical qualification. Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in fleet maintenance management. Proven experience managing commercial vehicle fleets and maintenance workshops. Practical knowledge of refrigerated trucks and transport refrigeration systems. Experience in FMCG, food distribution, or cold-chain operations is highly preferred. Required Skills Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices. Strong leadership, technical troubleshooting, cost-control, and analytical skills. Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with ERP and fleet management systems. Work Environment and Location This position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires the ability to travel to branches or operational sites when necessary to ensure effective oversight of fleet operations.

20658751f83bec61.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Lead Ethics Specialist to join its team in Jeddah. This contract position involves leading the development and implementation of proactive measures to reduce ethics violations, misconduct, fraud, and corruption within the Bank Group. The role focuses on ethics awareness, training, and contributing to the organization's learning and transformation into a knowledge-based institution. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on prevention activities and programs to ensure compliance with the Bank Group Code of Ethics. Handle complex, sensitive, and confidential assignments from the Director of the Department. Deliver ethics products and services to IsDB Group staff and provide oversight on the interpretation of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics and policies. Support the Director in developing and executing communications, training, education, and other prevention activities. Lead complex training and communications projects, including writing articles, giving presentations, and developing departmental communications. Oversee the preparation of annual reports and other written products for the Director. Assist in keeping IsDB Group Units informed on relevant ethics issues and oversee data analysis to identify trends and major issues. Recommend and implement policies, procedures, and targeted programs for the Department. Supervise consultants and oversee contracts as requested by the Director. Support activities related to allegations of staff misconduct and play a key role in reviewing and developing internal procedures and manuals for the Group Integrity and Ethics Department (GIED). Mainstream ethics in Bank Group policy documents and engage departments on lessons learned. Organize and oversee training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities, including developing materials for the prevention of staff misconduct. Lead the launch and implementation of the Financial Disclosure and Conflict of Interests Program. Undertake and report on staff misconduct investigations as assigned. Spearhead the identification and organization of collaborative partnerships with regional and international trainers for misconduct prevention programs. Knowledge Management Lead the organization and implementation of meetings, workshops, and video conferences to promote dialogue on integrity, knowledge sharing, and ethics. Provide administrative and technical support to Bank Group staff on ethics issues during major events. Lead the preparation of a periodic newsletter on Ethics Prevention and Outreach Products. Prepare annual integrity and ethics reports and ensure their publication on the Bank’s website. Lead special initiatives/projects and undertake other ad hoc assignments as required by the Director. Capacity Building and Advisory Lead, organize, and oversee the implementation of training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities for staff misconduct prevention. Lead in designing and developing innovative training tools and modules using data mining, media analyses, and compliance reviews. Lead the implementation of a Training and Awareness Plan for Bank Group staff. Advise IsDB Group Staff on the provisions of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Type This is a contract position based in Jeddah.

208c8637b0ab059a.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Tender & Estimation Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for managing the complete tendering and cost estimation cycle for restoration works, ensuring clarity, reliability, and transparency throughout the process. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to ensure that all tender documents are comprehensive, cost estimates are accurate, and bid evaluations are fair and defensible for procurement and audit review. The engineer will play a critical part in the successful execution of restoration projects by providing robust tendering and estimation support. Key Responsibilities Prepare comprehensive tender documents, including scope of work, technical requirements, bills of quantities, evaluation criteria, and commercial terms. Develop cost estimates and budgets for each work package. Consolidate technical input from discipline engineers into complete tender documents. Coordinate bidder site visits, respond to bidder clarifications, and issue addenda and extensions as required. Maintain tender schedules and records in accordance with company procurement policy. Conduct technical and commercial evaluations and benchmark bid prices against the cost estimate. Prepare bid comparison statements and award recommendations. Support the purchase requisition, purchase order, and contract award processes. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical) or Construction Management. Valid professional registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). Extensive experience in tendering and cost estimation for construction or facility projects. Proficiency in quantity take-off, BOQ preparation, cost estimation and cost analysis, FIDIC or equivalent forms of contract, and technical and commercial bid evaluation. Excellent written English for technical and contractual documents; Arabic is preferred. Demonstrated integrity, confidentiality, analytical thinking, attention to detail, accuracy, and negotiation skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

20e94a1fa2080e94.description: What you will do Monitor the platform around the clock, respond to alerts, troubleshoot, fix and restore service. Handle emergencies inside or outside office hours, and turn around any report the client asks Patch, harden and run regular vulnerability reviews on every component; keep endpoint protection compatible. Implement and operate the security controls: identity and access with MFA, RBAC and single sign-on; encryption everywhere; separated dev, test and production; signed and verified automation code; file-type whitelisting; mobile-device restrictions. Run security logging, audit logs and the SIEM integration; protect logs from tampering. Secure the APIs: gateway, OAuth 2.0, OWASP API security. Own backups, business continuity and disaster recovery, and test them. Run incident response: immediate notification, an initial report within 24 hours, documented procedures with SLAs and escalation. Write the security architecture and API design documents and the infrastructure parts of the architecture pack, and the bi-monthly operations report. What you need Linux and Windows server administration on public and sovereign clouds (GCP, OCI, Deem or similar) Administration of at least two of Qlik Sense, Talend, Dataiku and MS SQL Server, plus GCP services Monitoring and alerting (Cloud Logging and Monitoring, Prometheus and Grafana or similar) and runbooks Incident management: triage, escalation, root-cause reports Identity and access: IAM, MFA, RBAC, SSO integration Encryption at rest and in transit, key management, certificates Vulnerability scanning, patching and hardening; working with endpoint-protection tools SIEM integration and audit-log design API gateways, OAuth 2.0, OWASP API Security Top Ten Backup, restore, business continuity and disaster recovery in the cloud Good to have Terraform and CI/CD; SRE practice (SLOs, error budgets, cost alerts) MS SQL Server DBA depth Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP or ITIL Experience with national cybersecurity-control audits

2005ee582fcc4042.company_name: الجمعية الخيرية لرعاية الايتام بالمنطقة الشرقية ( بناء)
2005ee582fcc4042.description: About the Role MIS - Al Moammar Information Systems Co. is seeking an experienced Systems Engineering and Educational Systems Development Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves designing, developing, and integrating educational technology solutions, contributing to the advancement of e-learning systems. Key Responsibilities Design and develop systems and applications supporting the e-learning ecosystem. Develop technical solutions for Learning Management Systems (LMS), virtual classrooms, and electronic examination systems. Design and implement integration between educational systems and university systems such as SIS, IAM, and SSO. Develop and manage integration interfaces (APIs) and data exchange services. Analyze technical requirements and translate user needs into implementable solutions. Develop data analysis tools, reports, and dashboards. Research and develop Artificial Intelligence and predictive analytics solutions in the field of e-learning. Monitor system performance, address technical issues, and improve efficiency and reliability. Prepare technical documentation, system diagrams, and integration specifications. Review technical solutions provided by vendors and ensure their compatibility with technical requirements. Apply best practices in software engineering, application security, and Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 5-10 years of practical experience in engineering and developing educational systems and applications. Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) platforms and e-learning technologies. Strong knowledge of system integration, APIs, and web services. Experience integrating with university systems such as SIS, IAM, and SSO. Knowledge of software development, system architecture, and databases. Experience in data analysis, report generation, and dashboard creation. Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence applications and predictive analytics is a plus. High analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

204798303c48d834.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نايتس بريدج عن فني كهربائي أنظمة حماية كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية، وتحديد المواد والأجهزة اللازمة، ومتابعة أعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس بدقة. تحديد كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، وتأمينها لضمان سير العمل. متابعة الإجراءات التنفيذية لأعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس. تشخيص أعطال أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس، وتحديد أسبابها الجذرية، ومراقبة إجراءات الصيانة التصحيحية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات التنفيذية والرسومات الهندسية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المستخدمة في أنظمة الحماية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

204ba9b7543b7053.job_title: Senior and Lead Civil / Structural Engineers
204ba9b7543b7053.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise focused on innovation, providing end-to-end services from conceptualization to realization in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Opportunity KEO International Consultants is seeking Senior and Lead Design Engineers to join its full-time team. This role offers an environment that supports professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement. KEO fosters a culture that prioritizes company-wide health and well-being, providing access to on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. Employee Benefits and Support In addition to a competitive package and benefits, employees have access to a suite of policies designed to support work-life balance and professional growth. These include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards. Key Responsibilities Coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, clients, and specialist consultants. Applying knowledge of quality assurance and control procedures, technical reporting, and construction documentation. Working effectively in a project-based environment to meet demanding project schedules. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognized university. A master's degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage for selected senior positions. Relevant professional experience in engineering consultancy, construction supervision, design, infrastructure, or large-scale building projects. Demonstrated experience appropriate to the advertised role and level of responsibility. Strong understanding of engineering drawings, technical specifications, construction methods, and applicable codes and standards. Familiarity with engineering software and digital tools relevant to the discipline, such as AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, ETABS, SAP2000, or other discipline-specific applications, as applicable. Strong communication, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

20b23f7521775ba1.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - Commercial (Development Finance) to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves supporting the financial and commercial evaluation of development projects through detailed financial analysis, feasibility assessments, and investment insights. The specialist will contribute to funding strategies, financial modeling, and project performance monitoring to inform development and investment decisions. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to ensure financial data integrity, compliance, and reporting accuracy while supporting development finance objectives across the project lifecycle. The Senior Specialist will provide essential financial and commercial evaluation for various development initiatives, ensuring that all financial aspects are robustly managed and aligned with strategic goals. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain financial models for development feasibility studies, investment evaluations, and business case preparation. Analyze project financial performance, budgets, forecasts, cash flows, funding requirements, and capital expenditure plans. Support financial due diligence, valuation exercises, scenario analysis, and sensitivity assessments for development initiatives. Assist in preparing investment memoranda, financial reports, executive presentations, and governance submissions. Monitor project costs, financial commitments, and expenditure trends to identify risks and opportunities. Support funding strategy assessments and coordinate financial information for financing activities and stakeholder reviews. Collaborate with Development, Commercial, Accounting, Treasury, Procurement, and Project Delivery teams to ensure financial alignment. Review financial assumptions, project inputs, and commercial data for accuracy and consistency. Support the evaluation of strategic partnerships, commercial proposals, and investment opportunities. Ensure compliance with financial governance requirements, organizational policies, and reporting standards. Contribute to process improvement initiatives, reporting enhancements, and financial systems optimization. Provide technical and analytical support for ad hoc financial reviews, management requests, and strategic initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, development finance, or a related commercial field. A strong background in financial modeling, feasibility studies, and investment evaluation is required. Key Interactions The Senior Specialist will engage with various internal and external stakeholders to achieve objectives: Internal: Development Finance Team, Development Teams, Commercial Teams, Accounting and Finance Teams, Treasury Team, Procurement Team, Project Delivery Teams, and Executive Stakeholders. External: Financial Advisors, Consultants, Banks and Financial Institutions, Investors, External Auditors, and Strategic Partners. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

20b8fbad2ad7b7e3.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company comprised of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers, united by the goal of improving the world responsibly and safely. The company fosters a diverse workforce and attracts top talent through its emphasis on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. The Role of Flagman KBR, Inc. is seeking a Flagman to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern Region. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on ensuring site safety through effective traffic guidance and adherence to established protocols. Key Responsibilities Guide traffic on site to maintain smooth operations and prevent incidents. Ensure safe driving practices are followed by all personnel and vehicles. Maintain awareness and strict adherence to SATORP's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) rules. Possess proper knowledge regarding Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and its correct usage. Attend all scheduled safety and technical training sessions. Meet the requirements of competency-based training programs. Required Experience and Skills A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated understanding of site traffic management and safety protocols. Proficiency in applying HSE rules and regulations. Ability to effectively communicate and direct traffic. Work Environment and Development The Flagman will operate in a dynamic site environment, contributing to the overall safety culture. Continuous professional development is supported through mandatory safety and technical training, as well as competency-based programs designed to enhance skills and knowledge. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

206dc079df1dd123.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سمايا عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، بمنطقة عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة المطلوبة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية الأداء. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف، للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. معرفة جيدة بمعايير الجودة والمواد المستخدمة في أنظمة HVAC. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة سمايا في مدينة خميس مشيط، بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

20dba1d3c1daf5e3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وصول للدعاية والاعلان عن مدير تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة الأنشطة التسويقية الرقمية وتنسيق الحملات الإعلانية والمحتوى، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على أداء المنصات الرقمية المتنوعة لأحد مراكز الرفق بالحيوان. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة، وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وإدارة خطة المحتوى الشهرية عبر سبع منصات رقمية: إنستغرام، تيك توك، منصة X، فيسبوك، يوتيوب، لينكدإن، وسناب شات. التنسيق والإشراف على أعمال صانع المحتوى ومصمم الجرافيك وأخصائي التسويق بالأداء. إعداد تقارير الأداء الشهرية وربع السنوية والسنوية لمختلف الأنشطة التسويقية. الإشراف على الموقع الإلكتروني وتحديث محتواه بشكل مستمر لضمان حداثته وفعاليته. متابعة أداء الأنشطة التسويقية الرقمية بشكل دوري وتحديد فرص التحسين والتطوير. ضمان اتساق المحتوى والهوية البصرية عبر جميع المنصات الرقمية للحفاظ على صورة موحدة للعلامة التجارية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال التسويق الرقمي أو إدارة التسويق. فهم عميق للمنصات الرقمية المختلفة وأدوات التسويق الرقمي. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل المتخصصة في المحتوى والتصميم والأداء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية عالية ودقة في التعامل مع الأرقام والبيانات. القدرة على إعداد تقارير أداء مفصلة وتقديم توصيات بناءً عليها. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. القدرة على التفكير الاستراتيجي وتحديد فرص النمو والتحسين. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل مدير التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة وصول للدعاية والاعلان، وسيكون مسؤولاً عن قيادة الجهود التسويقية الرقمية لمشروع مركز الرفق بالحيوان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

20d9b00eac534043.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها مع الأطراف المعنية. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. فهم قوي لمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وشبكات النقل والتوزيع. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية والتشغيلية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي، في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمتطلبات المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة استشارية رائدة والمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية مهمة.

201a77f65aaf1ffc.description: Master Works is a Saudi technology company driving digital transformation through emerging technologies and innovative digital solutions. We empower organizations with expertise across data management, AI, software development, and digital strategy, contributing to the digital economy in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Master Works is looking for a SharePoint, Developer Senior with strong development and administration experience to implement, customize, and support on-premises SharePoint solutions across SharePoint Server 2016, 2019, and Subscription Edition. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain SharePoint portals, sites, and document management solutions. Build professional content pages using SharePoint's out-of-the-box features, including web parts, lists, libraries, layouts, and navigation. Develop custom workflows, forms, web parts, and integrations with business systems. Administer SharePoint farms, permissions, service applications, search, and configurations. Troubleshoot development, deployment, workflow, and farm performance issues. Support solution testing, deployment, updates, upgrades, migrations, backup, and recovery activities. Gather business requirements, prepare technical documentation, and provide user support and knowledge transfer. Apply secure development practices, source control, and code reviews. Prepare project progress and issue reports, incident and root-cause reports, and deployment and farm health reports as required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering. Relevant Microsoft certifications are preferred. Minimum 8 years of software development experience, including at least 5 years in SharePoint development and administration. Hands-on experience with SharePoint Server 2016, 2019, and Subscription Edition, including on-premises implementation and support. Strong skills in C#, .NET Framework, ASP.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, PowerShell, SharePoint APIs, and version-compatible SPFx. Experience with native SharePoint capabilities, custom workflows, forms, web parts, and system integrations. Solid knowledge of farm administration and troubleshooting, including Windows Server, IIS, SQL Server, Active Directory, and authentication. Experience with testing, deployments, upgrades, and migrations. Strong problem-solving, ownership, and attention to quality. Effective teamwork, clear communication, and customer-focused approach. Good time management and commitment to continuous learning. Arabic: Native proficiency. English: Fluent proficiency.

Research and collect market data for analysis, formulating recommendations aligned with JHAH HR objectives. The role requires an individual capable of performing detailed analytical tasks and contributing to strategic HR initiatives. Work Location This full-time position is based in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. 2056e6392cb96ec1.description: About the Role Almarai is seeking a Commercial Chef to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves integrating advanced baking and culinary expertise with strong commercial understanding to drive product innovation, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to business growth. The Commercial Chef ensures that all bakery offerings meet high-quality standards while aligning with commercial objectives, market demands, and profitability targets. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of new bakery products by applying technical expertise in ingredients, equipment, and processes, in line with market trends and customer preferences, to deliver commercially viable and innovative SKUs that support sales growth. Conduct production trials and technical validations, using standard procedures and collaboration with the operations team, to ensure that product prototypes can be scaled efficiently for full manufacturing runs without compromising quality. 20a8de637d73857c.description: About the Role HolyStar Arabia is seeking a Quality Foreman to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring product quality and conformity through meticulous electrical inspections and testing across IPQC and FQC activities, ultimately contributing to the final release of products. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to coordinate and execute electrical inspections and testing procedures. The Quality Foreman will be responsible for maintaining effective control over nonconformities and verifying product conformity before final release, upholding the company's quality standards. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and perform daily electrical inspection and testing activities. Review drawings, Bills of Material (BOMs), specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and acceptance criteria. Conduct factory routine tests, functional testing, and dielectric testing. Review inspection reports and test records. Coordinate Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and customer/witness inspections. Initiate and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and verify the implementation of corrective actions. Provide technical guidance to QC Inspectors and Testing Technicians. Coordinate with Production and Engineering departments to resolve quality issues. Ensure proper calibration, traceability, and control of QC records. Escalate significant or recurring quality issues to QC management. Meet the established targets for standard QC hours allocated per product type. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in quality control, electrical inspections, or a similar field. A strong understanding of quality assurance principles and testing methodologies is essential for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the HolyStar Arabia team. The role requires collaboration with various departments, including Production and Engineering, to address and resolve quality-related matters effectively. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

This full-time role focuses on driving Microsoft 365 Modern Workplace and Security solution opportunities, from initial qualification through solution design and technical positioning. The professional will be responsible for the specialist portfolio of Microsoft 365 Modern Workplace services, aiming to enhance customer productivity, collaboration, security, compliance, and digital workplace experiences. Key Responsibilities Own the technical qualification, discovery, and solution design processes for assigned opportunities. Translate customer business and technical requirements into comprehensive solution architectures, scopes of work (SoW), and services proposals. Design and position Microsoft 365 solutions across collaboration, security, compliance, identity, and endpoint management. Provide technical leadership for Microsoft 365 Security solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender suite, and Microsoft Sentinel. Support solution positioning for Microsoft Purview capabilities, such as Information Protection/Sensitivity Labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Insider Risk Management, and Compliance/Audit/eDiscovery. Assess customer environments and propose migration/transformation strategies for Microsoft 365 adoption, supporting various migration scenarios (On-premises to Microsoft 365, Cross-tenant, Google Workspace to Microsoft 365, Email/Collaboration workload migrations). Ability to recommend fit-for-purpose solutions based on customer environment, business goals, licensing models, and security/compliance requirements. Proficiency in identifying technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early in the process and proposing effective mitigation plans. Experience in preparing detailed technical proposals, configurations, and solution documents aligned with customer business objectives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role involves working closely with account managers, consultants, delivery teams, and technology partners to shape winning solutions, overcome technical blockers, and support the achievement of sales and gross profit targets.

20309038e27eaf1f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فيلفيت فايبز عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ الاستراتيجيات التسويقية للمنتجات والخدمات، مع التركيز على الورد والحفلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. المهام الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل النجاح أو الفشل، وتحليل أسعار المنافسين، وتطوير سياسات التسعير. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع، وتقييم فعالية الدعاية والإعلان. بناء الحملات الإعلانية الممولة على منصات مثل Google Ads، Instagram، و TikTok. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير التسويقية المتخصصة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المسؤوليات اليومية التواصل مع العملاء عبر الهاتف والبريد الإلكتروني، وتقديم العروض، ومتابعة الطلبات. إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي، ونشر المحتوى، والرد على الاستفسارات. تحديث المنتجات والأسعار والصور والعروض على تطبيقات الطلبات والموقع الإلكتروني. تصميم المنشورات واللافتات والمواد الإعلانية، وإعداد الفيديوهات القصيرة. إنشاء وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية على Google Ads، Snapchat، و Instagram. متابعة نتائج الحملات الإعلانية، وإعداد تقارير موجزة، واقتراح تحسينات لزيادة المبيعات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات في تحليل السوق وتحديد أسعار المنتجات. القدرة على بناء وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق مؤسسة فيلفيت فايبز في الرياض، في بيئة عمل بدوام كامل تركز على تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية وزيادة المبيعات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كأخصائي تسويق، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

2031668dadd4846e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرويس عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف الميداني على أعمال النظافة والصيانة في منفذ الرقعي، ويضمن جودة الخدمة من خلال توجيه الفنيين والعمال والتنسيق مع ممثل الهيئة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد جداول العمل اليومية المكاتب ودورات المياه والممرات والمواقف والواجهات، والتحقق من توفر المواد الاستهلاكية المعتمدة. استقبال بلاغات الصيانة وتصنيفها، وتوجيه الفنيين المختصين، ومتابعة التنفيذ والاختبار والتوثيق ضمن المهل التعاقدية. متابعة برامج الصيانة الدورية والوقائية، وإعداد التقارير والبرامج الشهرية بالتنسيق مع الفنيين وإدارة المشاريع. حصر الاحتياجات ورفع طلبات المواد وقطع الغيار، ومتابعة اعتمادها وتوريدها واستلامها وتوزيعها على المواقع. متابعة جاهزية المعدات وصيانتها وترقيمها، وتدريب العاملين على استخدامها، واستبعاد أي معدات غير آمنة أو مواد غير معتمدة. متابعة التزام العاملين بالزي الرسمي والبطاقات التعريفية والنظافة الشخصية والسلوك المهني، والمحافظة على ممتلكات الهيئة. متابعة تطبيق احتياطات السلامة وتأمين مواقع الصيانة، ووضع التحذيرات، وإبلاغ إدارة المشاريع وممثل الهيئة بالحوادث والمخاطر. إدارة العهدة النقدية المخصصة للصيانة الطارئة وفق صلاحيات الشركة، مع توثيق الصرف وتجديد الرصيد بما لا يقل عن 10,000 ريال. إعداد تقارير الإنجاز والحضور والمواد والأعمال المنفذة، ومتابعة الملاحظات والشكاوى، وتجهيز المستندات التشغيلية للمستخلص الشهري. الرد على اتصالات الجهة المشرفة والحضور خارج ساعات الدوام في حالات الصيانة الطارئة والعاجلة حسب متطلبات العقد. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو الإشراف على الأعمال الميدانية. القدرة على توجيه الفرق الفنية والعمالية بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التنسيق والمتابعة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة في منفذ الرقعي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويتطلب الدور التواجد الميداني والإشراف المباشر على سير العمل. ينتهي عقد العمل بانتهاء المشروع المحدد. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

20d5d8c5c5fba626.description: ملخص الوظيفة نبحث عن مسؤول علاقات حكومية (Public Relations Officer – PRO) ذي خبرة لإدارة العلاقات الحكومية في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيكون المرشح الناجح مسؤولًا عن ضمان حصول جميع عمليات الشركة على التراخيص والتصاريح والموافقات التنظيمية اللازمة، والمحافظة على سريانها. كما سيكون نقطة الاتصال الرئيسية للشركة مع الجهات الحكومية ذات الصلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية - الامتثال لأنظمة العمل: التنسيق مع إدارة الموارد البشرية لضمان الالتزام بمتطلبات التوطين (السعودة)، ونظام العمل، والتأمينات الاجتماعية. - التواصل مع الجهات الحكومية: العمل بصفته نقطة الاتصال الرئيسية للشركة مع الجهات الحكومية، والتعامل مع عمليات التفتيش والمخالفات والغرامات والاعتراضات، مع الالتزام بالمواعيد النظامية المحددة. - متابعة الامتثال والمتطلبات التنظيمية: إعداد ومتابعة جدول زمني يتضمن تواريخ انتهاء جميع التراخيص والتصاريح والإقامات، ومراقبة التغييرات في الأنظمة واللوائح، وإبلاغ الإدارة وإدارتي التسويق والعمليات التشغيلية لقطاع التجزئة بها مسبقًا. - تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى تقع ضمن الحدود المهنية المعقولة، وفقًا لما يكلّفه به مدير الموارد البشرية أو أعضاء الإدارة. أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية. خبرة لا تقل عن 8 سنوات في مجال العلاقات الحكومية أو شؤون العلاقات العامة الحكومية داخل المملكة العربية السعودية، ويفضّل أن تكون الخبرة في قطاع التجزئة بمدينة الرياض. خبرة عملية مباشرة في استخدام المنصات الحكومية السعودية والخدمات الإلكترونية. معرفة قوية بنظام العمل السعودي، والأنظمة التجارية وأنظمة حماية المستهلك، والمتطلبات البلدية. إجادة اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية شرط إلزامي. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وبناء العلاقات والتفاوض، مع الالتزام بالأسلوب المهني في التعامل مع المسؤولين الحكوميين. دقة عالية في العمل، ومهارات قوية في ضبط المستندات وإدارة المواعيد النهائية. امتلاك مهارات جيدة في حل المشكلات، وحسن التقدير واتخاذ القرارات، والقدرة على توجيه فريق صغير. إجادة استخدام برامج Microsoft Office، بما في ذلك Word وExcel وPowerPoint. احترام الثقافات والاتجاهات والمعتقدات والتقاليد المختلفة.

20118761a0f136a6.description: About the Role State Street Corporation is seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Core Operations. This full-time role involves leading end-to-end post-trade custody operations in Saudi Arabia, operating from Sunday to Thursday. The AVP will ensure service excellence, strong risk and control discipline, and regulatory adherence across the Saudi post-trade ecosystem, including trading on Saudi Exchange, clearing via Muqassa (CCP), and depository/settlement via Edaa, with cash movements supported through SAMA. Role Context and Importance State Street is a global custodian with over USD * trillion in AUC/A, executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market, supported by Vision 2030 reforms, increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical for enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering controlled post-trade operations aligned with local market infrastructure and rules, ensuring a high-quality client experience, and supporting the firm’s ability to deepen client relationships. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end post-trade custody operations, covering clearing & settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions/income, reconciliations, and client onboarding/account set-up. Drive service excellence, risk & control discipline, and regulatory adherence within the KSA post-trade ecosystem. Own daily settlement processing for Saudi Exchange trades, settling at Edaa in line with market cycles (standard T+2; negotiated deals T+0 to T+5, where applicable). Reconcile and validate client instructions, broker confirmations, and Muqassa clearing outcomes, proactively resolving exceptions and breaks. Monitor fails, manage aged items, and coordinate remediation according to Muqassa fails management processes and local cut-offs. Manage instruction lifecycle, including amendments, cancellations, and partial handling where permitted, while maintaining robust STP and control checks. Operational Analytics and Reporting Build and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Management Information Systems (MIS) for post-trade performance, including Straight-Through Processing (STP), settlement timeliness, fail rates, aged breaks, cash funding accuracy, FX confirmation timeliness, corporate action accuracy, and reconciliation break rates. Produce daily dashboards and monthly senior management packs detailing trends, root causes, remediation plans, and automation pipelines. Conduct capacity/utilization and coverage planning aligned with local market operating days (Sunday–Thursday coverage considerations). Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 10-12 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires a strong understanding of post-trade custody operations, clearing and settlement processes, and regulatory requirements within the financial services industry, particularly in the Saudi Arabian market. Work Environment This is a full-time position within State Street Corporation, focusing on operations in Saudi Arabia. The work schedule is Sunday to Thursday, aligning with local market operating days.

11,250 ريال سعودي التقديم إذا كنت تبحث عن تحديات جديدة ولديك الرغبة في التأثير الإيجابي على بيئة العمل، فإن هذه الفرصة مناسبة لك. ندعو المهتمين للتقديم.

2024786be25b851a.description: The Director – Organizational Development provides enterprise-wide leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and OD foundations across the group and its subsidiaries. The role ensures that organizational structures, roles, governance, and workforce capacity are aligned to business priorities, capital programs, and long-term growth ambitions. The role owns the organization’s OD frameworks, job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation governance, ensuring internal equity, role clarity, scalability, and operating effectiveness. The Director leads the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and business verticals, including structures, job frameworks, and workforce models, and provides governance oversight for structural changes across the group. As a strategic advisor to senior leadership and HR, the Director partners closely with Strategy, Finance, HRBPs, and business leaders to integrate workforce and organizational considerations into enterprise strategy, transformation programs, and growth initiatives. The role contributes to target operating model (TOM) development initiatives. The Director also builds and leads the Organizational Development function, setting delivery standards, governance processes, and quality controls, and developing OD capability, tools, and knowledge assets to ensure high-impact, analytically rigorous delivery. Scope / Responsibilities Enterprise Organizational Design & TOM Leadership Lead the design and continuous evolution of enterprise and functional target operating models (TOMs) aligned to strategy, growth plans, and operating context. Establish and govern organizational design frameworks, principles, and standards to ensure scalability, clarity of accountability, and operational effectiveness. Sponsor major restructuring, transformation, and capability-led design initiatives across corporate, business, and development functions. Oversee the design of organization structures, reporting lines, role charters, and governance forums to enable decision velocity and execution discipline. Guide leadership teams through structural scenario modeling and future-state organization design. OD Foundations for Group Companies & Subsidiaries Lead the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and group entities, including structure, grading architecture, job frameworks, and workforce models. Ensure consistent application of group-wide OD standards while allowing for contextual flexibility across entities. Partner with business and HR leadership to support post-merger integration, spin-offs, and new business vertical launches. Provide governance oversight for structural changes across the group to ensure alignment with enterprise design principles. Organizational Structure Effectiveness Oversee analysis of spans of control, workforce layering, and reporting lines to optimize leadership bandwidth, cost-effectiveness, and agility. Validate alignment between organizational structures, strategy, and operational delivery models. Lead enterprise-wide organizational diagnostics and effectiveness assessments. Approve and sponsor structural recommendations for leadership decision-making. Strategic Workforce Planning Leadership Own the enterprise workforce planning framework and annual/multi-year planning cycles in partnership with HRBPs and Finance. Ensure workforce supply–demand alignment to strategic priorities, major programs, and capital plans. Review and endorse workforce scenarios, capacity models, and productivity assumptions. Escalate material workforce risks and resourcing constraints to executive leadership. Job Architecture, Grading & Evaluation Governance Govern enterprise job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation methodologies. Ensure equity, internal consistency, and market alignment across roles and functions. Approve complex or sensitive role designs and grading outcomes. Ensure role clarity and structural integrity across growth and transformation phases. Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory Act as a strategic advisor to ExCo, business unit heads, and HR leadership on organizational effectiveness and structural design. Partner closely with Finance, Strategy, and HRBPs to integrate workforce, cost, and operating model considerations. Represent OD in enterprise transformation and growth initiatives. People Leadership & OD Capability Building Lead, mentor, and develop Senior Managers and the broader OD team. Build OD capability, tools, and knowledge assets across the function. Set delivery standards, quality controls, and governance processes. Drive a culture of analytical rigor, partnership, and business impact. Experience & Profile (Indicative) Minimum 12 years’ experience in Organizational Development, Operating Model Design, or Strategic HR roles. Proven experience in target operating model (TOM) design and enterprise transformation. Hands-on experience in setting up OD foundations for new subsidiaries or business entities . Experience working in group company environments with multiple subsidiaries . Strong background in strategic workforce planning, org design, and job evaluation . Exposure to or experience within development-sector organizations strongly preferred. Executive-level stakeholder engagement and governance leadership experience.

20e42779413fff95.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، والإشراف على التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل الدارات الكهربائية. إجراء فحوصات التمديدات الكهربائية مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض لضمان السلامة والكفاءة. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للتمديدات الكهربائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. فهم شامل لمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جازان، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتيح الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

20ac524db588c6b8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية، وسيكون بدوام كامل. سيساهم المهندس المدني في دراسة وتصميم المشاريع الإنشائية والإشراف على تنفيذها لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع، وتحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة. إجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصر المشروع. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. متابعة إعداد جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية وتدقيقها. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية والمعايير الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمشاريع الإنشائية. فهم عميق للمبادئ الهندسية الإنشائية وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف الميداني ومتابعة سير العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة لإعداد وتقديم التقارير الفنية. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة في جميع مراحل المشروع. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل في شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشروع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور والراتب.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in AI model development, deployment, cloud infrastructure, distributed computing, and MLOps/LLMOps to support scalable, high-performance AI applications. Key Responsibilities Develop, train, test, evaluate, and deploy AI/ML models and Generative AI applications. Design, implement, and optimize LLM-based solutions, including inference mechanisms and performance tuning. Build and manage scalable AI infrastructure using GCP, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker. Implement MLOps and LLMOps pipelines to automate model development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. Optimize LLM inference performance through distributed computing, inference benchmarking, and scaling strategies to meet SLAs/SLOs. Manage GPU-based workloads, distributed processing, and autoscaling for AI applications. Work with NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face, and NVIDIA SuperPOD environments, including HPC, Slurm, and Kubernetes. More than 5 years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related fields. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with cloud technologies such as GCP, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker. Strong understanding of AI/ML model training, testing, evaluation, and deployment. Practical knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, LLMs, and Generative AI. Understanding of LLM architecture, inference mechanics, and performance optimization. Experience in inference scaling, distributed computing, benchmarking, and GPU-based workloads. Familiarity with NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face, and NVIDIA SuperPOD environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication, teamwork, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to lead project activities and collaborate across technical teams.

201cc2874522113c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية، وإدارة مخزون الأدوية، وصرفها للمرضى مع تقديم الإرشادات اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيدلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تقييم احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات وتحديد أنواعها وكمياتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد وتدقيق طلبات الشراء، ومتابعة توفير الأدوية واستلامها وتخزينها بما يتوافق مع الأسس الصيدلانية وسجلات المخزون. مراجعة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الأدوية قبل صرفها للمستهلك. تقديم الإرشادات للمرضى حول طريقة الاستعمال الصحيحة والآثار الجانبية المحتملة للأدوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات تخزين وصرف الأدوية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الصيدلي ضمن بيئة مهنية تلتزم بالمعايير الصيدلانية وتوفر فرصاً لتطوير المهارات في مجال الرعاية الصحية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الكشف عنه.

20de81bd1c710886.description: About Jeeny: Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. By connecting you with your preferred mode of transportation, we are fulfilling our aim of making mobility accessible, affordable, and flexible for all. We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Jeeny was established in 2014 as Easy Taxi. However, in 2016, it was revamped as Jeeny to cater to other services. Currently, we are operational in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. We have offices in Riyadh, Jeddah, Madinah, Amman, Lahore, and Karachi. About the Role: As our Customer Communications Lead , you’ll own how we communicate with riders and drivers across all channels. You’ll bring structure to competing communication needs, set clear prioritisation rules, and ensure customers receive the right message at the right time. You’ll also lead experimentation across content, tone, offers and communication journeys, using A/B testing and performance data to understand what works and continuously improve our messaging. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong judgement, stakeholder management and analytical thinking, and wants to help shape the future of more automated and personalised customer communications. Responsibilities: Own our communications register, the definitive record of every message we send, who receives it, why it exists, who owns it, when it fires and how success is measured. Govern communications across teams and channels. Set and enforce the rules for frequency caps, suppression, priority, eligibility and exit criteria centrally, rather than one campaign at a time. Arbitrate competing sends, deciding which message reaches a customer at a contested moment and documenting the rationale. Design and run the A/B testing programme across content, maintaining a test register so experiments never collide on the same audience. Define the KPI for every message and work with data and engineering to close the gaps where performance cannot currently be read. Convert experiment results into a documented set of content standards for brand and content teams to apply at scale. Partner with data science on the automated decisioning engine, supplying the outcome data, guardrails and business rules it requires. Chair a regular planning forum where teams submit intended sends and leave with clear approvals, deferrals and rejections. Minimum 3 to 5 years in CRM operations, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation or campaign management, preferably within technology or consumer internet. Experience governing message volume across multiple internal stakeholders is essential. Hands-on experience with a customer engagement platform such as CleverTap, Braze, Iterable or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including segmentation, frequency capping, suppression and holdout groups. Working knowledge of experimentation: sample sizing, control design, significance, and the discipline not to read a result early. Proficiency in SQL is a significant plus. Experience in handling operational and crisis communications with clear escalation rules. Experience managing multilingual and multi-market customer communications is preferred Demonstrated ability to write a data specification and hold a credible technical conversation with data and engineering teams. Proven experience operating across cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities without formal authority. Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a decision clearly to the team it went against. What We Offer: An opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals while learning, growing, and expanding your skill set. An environment that encourages you to take ownership and produce excellent outcomes every day. Health benefits and insurance. Flexible working hours. Company Culture Jeeny is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace where all aspects of employment are solely based on merit. We value diversity and absolutely do not discriminate in any form based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, age, or mental or physical disability.

208e6b8004f441f3.job_title: CRM Dynamics Consultant - KSA - On-site - 4 Months
208e6b8004f441f3.description: About Octopus by RTG Octopus by RTG is the tech hiring and outsourcing arm of Robusta Technology Group , dedicated to connecting exceptional tech talent with top-tier organizations across the MENA, GCC, Europe, the US, and Canada . We specialize in building strong, long-term partnerships between skilled professionals and innovative companies. Our mission is to empower growth, innovation, and excellence by matching the right talent with the right opportunities. Key Responsibilities • Configure and customize Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, and business process flows to support the leasing journey: inquiry (RIF/TIF) capture, unit listing sync, offer/negotiation status, indicative terms, and lease sign-off. • Build and maintain the integration layer (in coordination with the API Developer) that pushes/pulls data between the Portal and Dynamics — e.g., unit availability, agent assignment, inquiry routing, booking confirmations, and lease-status transitions (Prospect → Offer → Signed→ Active → Renewal/Termination). • Develop plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom APIs within Dynamics to automate leasing-team notifications and approval steps (e.g., move-in request approvals,addendum requests, operational date changes). • Model and maintain the account hierarchy needed for sub-accounts (MHR-03, MUT-16/17) and company profiles (MUT-31) within Dynamics. • Support renewal and termination workflows by ensuring Dynamics reflects and triggers portal-side renewal notifications (SRR/SRT) and termination/settlement records (FCR/FCT). • Build reporting/dashboards in Dynamics (or Power BI) for the leasing and community-management teams to track inquiries, conversions, and portal-driven activity. • Manage security roles, field-level permissions, and data-privacy configuration within Dynamics for portal-originated records. • Participate in data-mapping and (if scoped as a change request) data-migration exercises between legacy systems and Dynamics. • Support UAT for all CRM-dependent features and provide production support during hypercare. Required Skills & Experience • 4+ years hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Engagement) development and configuration experience. • Strong command of the Dynamics customization toolkit: plugins (C#), custom workflows, Power Automate, Dataverse, and the Dynamics Web API / Common Data Service. • Experience integrating Dynamics with external web/portal applications via REST APIs or Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management). • Solid understanding of the real-estate/leasing domain (or comparable long-sales-cycle CRM use case: inquiry → offer → contract → renewal/termination) is a strong plus. • Experience with Power BI or Dynamics native reporting for operational dashboards. • Familiarity with Dynamics security model (business units, roles, field security) and data-privacy considerations for resident/tenant personal data. • Working knowledge of e-signature and document-generation integrations within Dynamics (e.g., DocuSign for Dynamics) is a plus. • Microsoft certification (e.g., MB-210, MB-220, or PL-400) is preferred but not required. Success Criteria for This Engagement • CRM-dependent leasing features (JCR-06, JCT-06/10–13, and lease-status transitions across both portals) are correctly synced and demonstrable end-to-end. • Leasing and community-management teams can operate their day-to-day workflow from Dynamics with no manual re-entry of portal-originated data. • Reporting/dashboards give the Client visibility into portal-driven leasing activity.

2082c162f41e1298.job_title: Functional Analyst (PM | SAP IS-Oil) - Saudi Arabia

The ideal candidate will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business requirements are effectively translated into SAP functionalities and solutions. Conduct requirement gathering sessions with business users to understand operational needs and translate them into functional specifications. Analyze business processes and map them to SAP IS-Oil and SAP PM functionalities . Lead and support the implementation of SAP IS-Oil solutions , ensuring proper integration with other SAP and non-SAP systems. Handle day-to-day user queries and system-related issues , ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. Prepare detailed functional specifications (FS documents) and collaborate with technical teams to develop and deliver customized solutions. Conduct end-user training sessions for different business roles to ensure effective system utilization. Mentor and train junior consultants , enhancing team capability in SAP IS-Oil. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong hands-on experience in SAP IS-Oil and SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) . Experience in post go-live support and enhancement projects . Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

20fd061b5b557e62.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Site Electrical Engineer to oversee and supervise all electrical construction activities on-site. The successful candidate will ensure that electrical works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, quality standards, and project schedules while coordinating with consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams. Key Responsibilities Supervise and monitor all electrical installation works on-site, ensuring compliance with approved drawings and project specifications. Review electrical shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Coordinate electrical activities with civil, architectural, mechanical, and other project disciplines. Conduct site inspections to verify the quality of electrical installations and ensure compliance with project requirements. Ensure compliance with local electrical regulations, international codes, and health and safety requirements. Review as-built drawings and verify completed electrical installations before project handover. Assist in evaluating technical variations, change orders, and site modifications. Maintain accurate records of inspections, approvals, testing results, and site activities. Support the successful testing, commissioning, and handover of electrical systems. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical site supervision for construction projects. Experience in commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects. Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution, lighting systems, low-current systems, grounding, and lightning protection. Familiarity with local and international electrical codes and standards. Professional engineering registration or relevant accreditation is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in AutoCAD , Revit , and Microsoft Office . Ability to review electrical drawings, calculations, and shop drawings. Knowledge of electrical testing, commissioning, QA/QC procedures, and inspection processes. Experience with project management software is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong site supervision and coordination skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Time management and ability to work under pressure. Teamwork and leadership abilities. Strong reporting and documentation skills.
